declared.what: the first declared case: gas at 900 °C and 400 W/(m² K), no oil film; with the heat paths, no oil path at all: the cam-housing face and the barrel's crankcase faces are in air

declared_oil.what: the first declared case with the oil film, the cam housing and the crankcase

published_loading_oil.what: the first case's published-loading variant: chamber, exhaust port and now barrel bore scaled to the published wall loadings

published_loading_oil_air_233.what: the same with the air film, and so the fin film, at Mackerle's upper bound of 233 W/(m² K)

sensitivity.rule: one value at a time to each end of its declared range, at the reference conductivity, with the calibrated coefficients of the variant held fixed

perfect_contact_witness.what: the reference configuration with every joint at a conductance a thousand times the declared value, against the same mesh with shared nodes (perfect contact, no contact pairs)

claims: peak temperatures under declared hypothesis cases: hypothetical valves, guides, plugs and barrel, declared joint conductances, films uncorrelated with any engine, room-temperature conductivities. Not an engine temperature, not a material qualification

joint_witness.what: two materials labelled by centroid across a plane (20 mm cube) or a cylinder (tube 5 to 20 mm), split and tied by one contact pair at 10,000 W/(m2 K) scaled by the projected-area factor; heat carried between two fixed temperatures against the closed-form answer for the smooth interface

mesh_comparison.rule: the comparison mesh is extracted from the same occupancy at a finer pitch and solved at the reference configuration; a second mesh at the base pitch gives the run-to-run spread of Gmsh HXT

first_screen.what: the same four variants without the heat paths: perfect contact, the cylinder as one film, oil on the pockets only
